evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml (step1.patch L33-65) runs on pull_request and runs `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in site/. These are real scripts in app/site/package.json L8-18, and `pretest` and the svelte-check in `build` cover lib/ too. Top-level `permissions: contents: read`. pages.yml grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` only to the deploy job (L115-117). release.yml uses `contents: write` with `github.token` only. There is no pull_request_target and nothing was run or published. However, every action is pinned to a mutable major tag rather than a full commit SHA: actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, upload-pages-artifact@v3 and deploy-pages@v4 (L55-56, 98-99, 107, 123, 148-149). That fails the pinning requirement in all three workflows. pages.yml also adds `workflow_dispatch` (L77), which can be started on any branch, so deployment is not strictly limited to `main`; only the github-pages environment's default branch rule would stop it. PAGES_BASE is wired to vite.config.ts L11.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch L283-334) covers the directory layout, requirements, install (`cd site && npm ci`), develop/test/build/preview/prepare-data/sample-bullets, data contribution steps with sourcing guidance and issue templates (which exist in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/), releases and the MIT license (LICENSE exists). Every npm command shown exists in site/package.json. Minor: it refers to a development container at `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` (L295), which is not present in the app/ snapshot.
evidence.s1_release: The version lives in site/package.json (0.1.0). CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 + SemVer and has an [Unreleased] section. CONTRIBUTING.md L238-269 defines SemVer rules for a data project and a tag-triggered release. release.yml checks that the tag equals the version in package.json, extracts the changelog section with awk, rebuilds and runs `gh release create`. Dependabot covers npm in /site and github-actions. The convention is Conventional Commits, and all 5 commits in commits.txt follow it. Small inconsistencies: CONTRIBUTING says `Dependabot commits use chore(deps)` and dependabot.yml uses prefix `chore`, but the type table assigns dependencies to `build`. The agent's own commit `15c6ecc build(deps): update npm packages and actions with Dependabot` describes a dependency update that it did not perform; it only added the config.
evidence.s2_requirements: diff/step2.patch is empty and commits.txt has no step 2 commit. app/site/src has no compare route, no `Compare with` select or `Compare` button, no `Profiles of …` SVG, no `Dimensions (mm)` table and no German strings (grep for compare/Vergleich finds only unrelated comments and strings). None of the requirements are met.
evidence.s2_correctness: No compare view was implemented (empty step2.patch), so there are no values, differences, units or profiles to judge.
evidence.s2_fit: No code was added in step 2 (empty step2.patch), so nothing reuses lib/shapes2d, lib/render2d, lib/core or the site components.
evidence.s3_fixes: diff/step3.patch is empty and there is no step 3 commit. Neither the missing one-sided dimensions bug nor the right-alignment point was addressed; the view they refer to does not exist.
evidence.cross_step: Steps 2 and 3 produced no changes: no CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased], no version change and no commits in the stated Conventional Commits convention. The CHANGELOG has only step 1 entries (all.patch L189-207).

unmet_requirements: Step 1: actions are not pinned to full commit SHAs (all workflows use @v3/@v4 tags)
Step 1: Pages workflow also runs on workflow_dispatch, so it is not limited to main or tags
Step 2: no `#/compare/<a>/<b>` route that opens directly and survives a reload
Step 2: no overlaid SVG of both caseOuterProfile outlines with role img and the name `Profiles of A and B`
Step 2: no dimensions table with caption `Dimensions (mm)`/`Dimensions (in)`, the headers Symbol/A/B/Difference, or FIELD_LABELS symbols
Step 2: no metric/imperial unit handling via formatValue/displayNumber
Step 2: no `Compare with` select and `Compare` button on the detail page
Step 2: no tests, changelog entry or commit
Step 3: dimensions published by only one cartridge are not listed with empty cells
Step 3: number columns and their headers are not right-aligned
Step 3: no changelog entry or commit
strengths: CI and Pages workflows run the repository's real scripts (`npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in site/), with least-privilege permissions scoped per job and only GITHUB_TOKEN

The release strategy is coherent: the version is in site/package.json, Keep a Changelog is stated, and the tag-triggered workflow checks the tag against the version and extracts the release notes from the changelog
The README and CONTRIBUTING are accurate for a new contributor; every command they show exists, and the 5 step 1 commits follow Conventional Commits
issues: Step 2 (the compare view feature) was not implemented at all: step2.patch is empty and there is no route, SVG, table, select, German strings or tests
Step 3 review fixes were not made: step3.patch is empty, and neither the one-sided dimensions bug nor the right-alignment point was addressed
No action in any workflow is pinned to a full commit SHA, and pages.yml's workflow_dispatch lets deployment be started from branches other than main
review.verdict: Step 1 is solid repository setup: correct checks, sensible permissions, a consistent tag-based release process with Keep a Changelog, and accurate contributor docs. Its one real gap is that no action is pinned to a commit SHA. Steps 2 and 3 produced no changes at all, so the requested feature and review fixes are entirely missing and the work cannot be merged.
